 Judgment
The present appeal is filed by the claimant seeking for enhancement of compensation.
2. Factum of accident is not in dispute.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the material on record.
4.
The appellant has filed IA No.1/2019 for condonation of delay of 1689 days in filing the appeal.
The delay is about 5 years in preferring the appeal.
The only explanation offered by the appellant is that due to financial difficulty, the delay is occurred in preferring the appeal.
In the cause title the claimant is shown as businessman.
Therefore, the reason assigned by the appellant for cause of delay is not convincing and cogent one so as to condone the delay.
The delay is 1689 days, which is about to 5 years.
Therefore, IA No.1/2019 is hereby dismissed.
Consequently, the appeal also stands dismissed.

SD/-
